sql_log.purpose: Use the frozen graph to locate shared dependencies and alternative verification leverage points.
sql_log.sql:
with edges as (
 select x->>'caller' as caller,c.value #>> '{}' as callee
 from public.lf_eventos e
 cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x
 cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(x->'callees') c
 where e.id=20161
)
select callee,count(*) as incoming_declared_edges,count(distinct caller) as distinct_callers,
       jsonb_agg(caller order by caller) as callers
from edges
group by callee
order by incoming_declared_edges desc,callee

with f as (
 select p.oid,n.nspname,p.proname,octet_length(p.prosrc) as body_bytes,
        md5(regexp_replace(lower(p.prosrc),'\s+','','g')) as normalized_body_md5
 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
 and (p.proname ilike '%input_governance%' or p.proname ilike '%input_readiness%')
), g as (
 select normalized_body_md5,count(*) as object_count,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',oid,'schema',nspname,'name',proname,'body_bytes',body_bytes)
                  order by nspname,proname,oid) as objects
 from f group by normalized_body_md5 having count(*)>1
)
select * from g order by object_count desc,normalized_body_md5

from (
 select 'FUNCTION'::text as object_type,n.nspname as schema_name,p.proname as object_name

 where n.nspname in ('programacion','public')
   and (p.proname ilike '%context%' or p.proname ilike '%manifest%' or p.proname ilike '%cached%')

   and (c.relname ilike '%context%' or c.relname ilike '%manifest%' or c.relname ilike '%cache%')
   and (c.relname ilike '%input%' or c.relname ilike '%governance%')
) s
order by object_type,schema_name,object_name
